title: iria hanceana
intro: Iria hanceana, commonly known as the Chinese Iria, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The health benefits of Iria hanceana include its ability to alleviate inflammation, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a useful remedy for various health issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Iria hanceana include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
